name: Bridge March

instructions.description: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Lift into a glute bridge and stabilize the pelvis.
Without dropping the hips, lift one foot a few centimeters off the floor, then place it down and alternate sides.
Lower the hips to the mat with control when the set is complete.

performanceMetrics.notes: Count alternating leg lifts while maintaining a level pelvis.

variations.variationDescription: Adds alternating single-leg loading to the basic bridge.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Hold the bridge without marching to regress the exercise.

commentsNotes: Keep the hips level during each march.
Take smaller marches if the pelvis shifts.
